items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I remember when I was in the eighth grade, I played Beethoven's Opus 49

ctx.x: You had two brothers, then. And two sisters.

Yeah. And we got along pretty good, and while I was in Everett I went to school there and during the school, during that term I used to take care of the doctor's horse and then I had a paper route, you know, sell papers go around there and then in the summertime I'd go in the factory, shoe factory and cut uppers. Oh, I was very industrious. Anyway I kept my music up and I remember when I was in the eighth grade, I played Beethoven's Opus 49 and my mother said why did you duck-bow and I said oh, them kids, they…
And then in the first -- I mean, freshman in high school, my mother died and my father had just built a house across the street and she didn't even live to enter it, and
